actions_or_findings.title: PHR006-B4 CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER — locked PATCH reads can retain stale values
actions_or_findings.trigger: Another transaction changes a building or unit after the new PATCH path loads it with Session.get but before its scoped SELECT FOR UPDATE completes.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The locking queries in backend/app/repository/property.py:88 and :137 do not refresh an object already loaded in the session. A partial PATCH can therefore write an update audit containing an outdated code or name. The saved tests and runtime evidence cover sequential edits, not this interleaving. This directly affects the new maintenance and audit paths.

actions_or_findings.title: PHR006-N1 NON_BLOCKING — quoted-newline CSV round trip
actions_or_findings.trigger: An exported building or unit name contains a quoted newline and is pasted back into import.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The unchanged parser splits rows on newlines before processing CSV quotes, so that valid exported value cannot round trip. FIX-1 adds no severity evidence.

actions_or_findings.title: PHR006-R1 RELEASE_BLOCKER — shared RabbitMQ replay
actions_or_findings.trigger: Formal release validation uses the shared RabbitMQ vhost and queue.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The handoff records an unresolved replay task there. Its last recorded queue observation was not refreshed in this review. This issue is separate from the safe local property archive slice.
